errors.evidence: The description of the vertical axis omits its unit, which is "篇" (articles), as indicated by the label "发文量/篇".
The description incorrectly identifies the color for Beijing University (北京大学) as purple (紫色). In the chart, it is represented by light blue.

errors.text_span: 北京外国语大学（浅灰色）
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly identifies the color for Beijing Foreign Studies University (北京外国语大学) as light gray (浅灰色). In the chart, it is represented by a dark gray/black color, while light gray represents Shandong University (山东大学).
The description incorrectly identifies the color for Nankai University (南开大学) as white (白色). In the chart, it is represented by a gold/dark yellow color. There are no white segments in the chart.

errors.text_span: 某些柱状图在视觉上被强调，例如高度较高的柱状图
errors.evidence: This statement is ambiguous because it confuses a data property (a larger value resulting in a taller bar) with a deliberate visual emphasis feature (like a special color, outline, or annotation). The chart does not apply any special visual emphasis.
